definition: Shell sequence paths defined in the hexagonal lattice using coordinates (h,k) where h,k are non-negative integers
assumptions: Hexagonal lattice provides the geometric framework for icosahedral shell construction
Seven chiral categories (MC, BG, Ch1-Ch5) classify different shell stacking arrangements
Size mismatch between adjacent shells determines structural stability
non_negotiable_steps: Compute size mismatch delta = |r_outer - r_inner| / r_inner
Match delta to optimal mismatch ranges for shell category assignment
Validate theoretical predictions against experimental measurements
Use LJ potential for interatomic energy calculations
